segments.he: שֶׁיְּהוּ קוֹרְאִין בַּמִּנְחָה בַּשַּׁבָּת – מִשּׁוּם יוֹשְׁבֵי קְרָנוֹת.
segments.en: The Gemara analyzes these ordinances, the first of which is «that» communities «shall read» the Torah «on Shabbat afternoon.» This Gemara explains that this ordinance was instituted «due to those who sit» idly on street «corners,» who do not attend the synagogue during the week.
